relics.description.knef_bow.description: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Knephmtyti, goddess of Death, this bow commands the power of storms, smiting anyone who dares defy the Goddess’ will with bolts of lightning.
relics.description.knef_bow.ability.shot: Shoots out %1$s beams of moonlight that track nearest targets and deal %2$s points of damage. Each shot drains %3$s% of the user's max HP.
Now arrows ricochet off walls and surfaces, like splashes of water from a vessel spilled upon the ground.
relics.description.knef_bow.ability.swim: Fires arrows at nearby enemies during a forward dash.
While this ability is active, using the Bow while submerged or under rain will send you forward for up to %3$s seconds, flying %1$s blocks per second and dealing %2$s damage to enemies in your way.
relics.description.knef_bow.ability.stor:
Hold Shift while charging and shoot an Arrow into the sky to summon the Eye of the Storm. For %3$s seconds it calls down thunder and rain in a radius of %1$s blocks, dealing %2$s damage to targets below and healing %4$s% of your max HP. Shooting into the ground unleashes a powerful discharge, striking nearby enemies with chain lightning.
Cooldown: 60s.
relics.description.ronas_sword.descripti: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Rhonas, god of War, this blade can decimate entire armies with its corrosive venom.
relics.description.ronas_sword.ability.s: Each swiping attack releases a wave of potent venom in a range of %1$s blocks. Affected targets take continuous damage for %2$s seconds, stacking up to %3$s times. Attacking too fast poisons the user instead.
Creatures marked with Ronas's stacks explode upon death, dealing damage equal to %1$s stacks in an area and spreading half of the stacks around.
relics.description.ronas_sword.ability.f:
Pressing Shift + RMB with the Fang will create a toxic cloud, poisoning all enemies in a radius of %1$s blocks for %2$s seconds.
Cooldown: %3$s seconds.
The cloud's radius is increased by 25%, and its duration by 50%. The cloud now also shreds armor.
relics.description.ronas_sword.ability.a: You feel the poison running through your veins, reducing healing from all sources by %1$s% and lowering your weapon attack speed to %2$s while the blade is in your inventory.
relics.description.montu_hammer.descript: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Montu, god of Labor, this hammer is capable of both bringing down mountains and stripping the earth of its treasures.
Pretend to be a god, smashing fellow mortal earth with your mighty hammer!
Pressing Shift+RMB on a block will create a shockwave with a radius of %2$s blocks, causing all ores below to spit out onto the surface.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds.
The power of the God of Labor allows you to tear through the Earth's crust with ease, expanding the mining area up to %1$sx%1$s blocks. Use Shift + Mouse Wheel to control the Hammer's might.
If the Hammer is enchanted with Fire Aspect, it can smelt a block with a probability of %2$s%, increased proportionally to the effect level.

When pressing Shift + LMB, unleashes a burrowing vortex in the direction the player is facing, with a power of %3$s units — the harder the rock it breaks, the more power is consumed. When passing through creatures, it slows down slightly and deals %2$s damage to them. Cooldown: %1$s seconds.
relics.description.seliaset_horn.descrip: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Seliaset, goddess of Fertility, this horn allows its user to harness the power of Mysr’s desert winds.
relics.description.seliaset_horn.ability: Blow into the Horn to unleash a powerful wind current, pushing all enemies away from you within %1$s blocks at a speed of %2$s blocks per second. Holding Shift will reverse the effect, pulling them towards you instead.

Pressing Shift + LMB will unleashe a series of %1$s shockwaves around the caster, sending surrounding enemies flying and slowing them for %3$s seconds.
Cooldown: %2$s seconds.
Hold Shift + right-click to summon a powerful vortex that pulls in creatures within a %2$s-block radius for %1$s sec. Cooldown: %3$s sec.
The wind current can now affect creatures immune to knockback.
relics.description.knef_rose.description: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Knephmtyti, goddess of Death, this eerie flower gives its user the power to control Death itself.
relics.description.knef_rose.ability.und: Harnessing the power of the death goddess, the Rose gives birth to creatures from the souls of the dead. In your inventory, while holding bones, left-click the Rose's slot to replenish %2$s souls per bone, or Shift + left−click Soul Sand to absorb up to %3$s soul(s) per block. Maximum capacity is %1$s souls. Hold Shift + right−click to expend two−thirds of the stored souls to summon creatures with up to %4$s of the maximum health of creatures native to the area where the player stands.
relics.description.knef_rose.ability.liv: Any animal or enemy killed by the Rose's owner has a %1$s% chance to resurrect as a Shade (a restless soul) with %2$s% of the slain creature's max health. With a %3$s% chance, the souls of the most resilient and strong-willed creatures degenerate into Howling Shades, which hurl withering projectiles at enemies. At the end of its life, any Shade leaves behind a suffocating cloud in its place, dealing damage.
relics.description.knef_rose.ability.rot: Remains, born of the Rose's powers, have a %1$s% chance to continue their life, splitting into up to %3$s% smaller shades, each with %2$s% of the original’s max HP.
relics.description.knef_rose.ability.liv: A creature slain by a Shade may degenerate into another Shade with a probability equal to %4$s% of the current Shade spawn chance.
relics.description.knef_rose.ability.und: For each stored soul, the Rose increases the damage of summoned Shades by %5$s and their lifespan by %6$s seconds.
relics.description.knef_rose.ability.liv: At the end of their existence, Howling Shades transform into a self-guiding clot of darkness that deals heavy damage to an enemy and leaves behind a suffocating cloud at that location.
relics.description.seliaset_sun.descript: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Seliaset, goddess of Fertility, the Sun nurtures life in both flora and fauna. But be warned - those who dare come close to the light might burn to ash.
While you stand under the sun, it deals no damage to you now.

Place the Sun into the world to return it to its true form. While the Sun is active, it advances the growth of all crops in a radius of %3$s blocks every %1$s seconds. Nearby animals have a %2$s% chance to give birth to twins.

The Sun burns nearby undead in a radius of %3$s blocks, dealing %2$s damage each 0.5 seconds. Items and blocks that stay under the Sun for longer than %1$s seconds are smelted as if they were in a Furnace.
If the player is in a dark place within %2$s blocks of the Sun, every %1$s seconds it will hurl a luminous energy clot at a random nearby location
The growth acceleration effect also applies to sugar cane and nether wart. Animals grow faster.
With at least %4$s saturation points, the shield can block all effects of an explosion.
Now you can dash into the air! Almost flight! On budget-friendly rage fuel.
relics.description.ronas_shield.descript: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Rhonas, god of War, this shield can repel any attack, retaliating back with a wave of raging flames.
Raise the shield, blocking %1$s% of incoming damage and converting it to %3$s hunger damage per point. While blocking, movement speed is reduced by %2$s%.

The Shield accumulates blocked damage, charging up to a max level of %1$s,  at a rate of 1 level per %2$s points of damage. Press LMB while guarding to release the stored energy, dealing %3$s damage per charge and knocking enemies away.
Raise your shield and press Ctrl to charge forward for %1$s seconds, knocking away all enemies in your path, dealing %2$s damage and stunning them for %3$s seconds.
relics.description.scroll_of_truth.descr: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Khatinthep, the god of Knowledge, this scroll can elevate the user’s consciousness, imparting ancient secrets of the arcane.
relics.description.scroll_of_truth.abili: Using the Scroll will open an Enchantment menu, allowing you to select specific enchantments to put on any. Experience cost modifier: %1$s. Max enchantment level: %2$s.
The Scroll's arcane powers grant you permanent level %1$s potion effects, indicated by the color of the scroll's seal. Use Shift + Mouse Wheel to change the applied effect.
It turns out the scroll contains hidden texts on the mastery of enchanting. Now you can enchant items 1 level above the maximum.
Upon slaying enemies, you gain a random effect of level %1$s for 10 seconds.
relics.description.montu_gloves.descript: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Montu, god of Labor, these gloves hold the secrets of Aurytekh forging, while also allowing the wearer to craft, build, and mine more efficiently.
Increases mining and attack range %1$s blocks and mining speed by %3$s%. Items enchantable with Unbreaking consume %2$s% less durability.
With these gauntlets, smithing strikes are precise and accurate; tool repairs require %4$s% fewer resources, and there is a %4$s% chance that an enchantment book will be preserved after forging.

Upgrade this ability to unlock Anvil Pocket Edition! Level up further to unlock other tools:
Level 2: Pocket Smithing Table
Level 3: Pocket Stonecutter
Level 4: Pocket Workbench
Also offers a %1$s% discount on anvil enchantments and repairs.

For many years, the lovestruck Montu studied the divine powers of relics, devising a way to reach the heavens. But even their might proved insufficient — yet his studies bore fruit. By combining any relic with an Auritech ingot and a vial of experience, one can significantly strengthen it, adding %1$s experience.

This ability allows the user to forge the divine metal, Aurytekh. Combine a Nether star and a block of emerald with a netherite ingot to create one aurytekh ingot. Two ingots can, in a similar fashion, be combined with some of the advanced gear to upgrade them. Aurytekh can be used as fuel for a Beacon, boosting its effectiveness.
relics.description.hett_feather.descript: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Khatinthep, the god of Knowledge, this quill records all of the user’s experiences, allowing for the accumulated knowledge to be used in battle.
Each experience point you pick up gives you %1$d points of health.

Press RBM with feather on a mob under %2$s points of health spawns a book that slams it between its pages and transforms into a level %1$s Talisman. While equipped, this talisman ups your damage and luck against enemies of the same type, as well as damage resistance against their attacks.
Cooldown: %3$s seconds.

Clicking Shift + RMB on a block will spawn a Book of Rebirth, consuming 1 book from your inventory. Should you die within %1$d blocks of it, the Book instantly teleports you to itself and heals you back to full HP. Be warned - enemies can destroy the Book of Rebirth, causing you to lose %2$s% of your XP and %3$s% of your health.
The Book of Rebirth now restores %4$s health per second and also provides a weak retaliatory strike against monsters attacking it within a small radius.

The Bestiary has grown thicker; a single tome can now hold up to %5$s creature types. Hold Shift to use the existing tome when activating the ability.If the tome already contains information about the victim′s type, it restores %4$s durability.
relics.description.traveller_sword.descr: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Being a shard of a Time paradox, this blade allows its wielder to travel vast distances, unbound by laws of time and space.
relics.description.traveller_sword.abili: While sprinting with the Sword in your hand, your movement speed will be gradually increased, reaching its maximum  after %1$s seconds of sprinting. Running through enemies will make them take %2$s% of the Sword’s damage. Performing an attack at maximum sprinting speed will summon a spectral blade to deal %3$s% of the Sword’s damage to enemies in front of you.

Press RBM to perform a dash %1$s blocks forward and deal %2$s% of the sword's damage to all enemies in your path.
Cooldown: %3$s seconds.

Once every %2$s seconds, by striking with a sword while holding Shift, you can summon a Phantom Blade. It crashes down upon the heads of enemies, dealing %1$sx sword damage and moving the player to the tip of its blade.
Using the Dreff grants the player a %4$s% speed boost, exceeding the maximum value. At this surpassing speed, the player deals 6 times more damage when passing through mobs.
The phantom blade now makes a full revolution around the player.
After a vertical strike, the phantom blade performs a horizontal slash, identical to the one used when summoning it at high speed.
relics.description.jodah_staff.descripti: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Being a shard of a Time paradox, this blade allows its wielder to travel vast distances, unbound by laws of time and space.
relics.description.jodah_staff.ability.r:
Successful attacks improve the weapon’s Perfection rank (ranging from §lD§r to §lS§r). Taking a hit yourself brings the rank down 2 levels. The higher the rank, the more XP each attack with the Staff will consume, in turn dealing more damage.
Rank progression requires  %1$s less strike.
relics.description.jodah_staff.ability.h:
Press Shift + RBM to activate ability. For the next %4$s seconds you will drain health and xp from the nearest %2$d target(s). The range of this ability and the amount of XP and health drained depends on the weapon’s Perfection rank. You gain %3$s% more XP from this ability.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds.
relics.description.jodah_staff.ability.o:
Upgrade this ability to unlock the Staff’s true potential. Reveals all living creatures in a large radius. Select a target and right-click to instantly teleport to it, dealing minor AoE damage. Perfection rank §lA§r and higher allows the user to teleport to the same target twice.
Cooldown: 60 seconds.
relics.description.jodah_staff.ability.r: Now, upon taking damage, the staff's rank is only lowered to the previous one
relics.description.jodah_staff.ability.h: The vital essence no longer heals the player when at maximum health; instead, it grants a shield of up to twice their maximum health.
relics.description.jodah_staff.ability.o: While 'A Thousand Eyes' is active, the player gains an additional ability to place a mark where they stand. When the ability ends, you are returned to that mark.

Normally, the staff's power suffices to reveal creatures' locations only once, at the start of the ability. However, if its rank is §lA§r or §lS§r, creatures within half the radius will be revealed with every movement you make.
relics.description.jodah_mask.descriptio: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Lololowka, one of the First, this mask gives its wearer complete control over their Spark, allowing to wield the powers of both Time and Anti-Time at will.
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.pl:
The player disappears from the world for %2$s seconds, becoming invisible, immobile, and invulnerable (press Shift to cancel). Restores 2 HP for each scint charge consumed.
§fᤁ§r: Grants 1 scint charge.
§fᤂ§r: Damages nearby mobs and gives them 1 antiscint charge.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds. §fᤀ§r §fᤁ§r §fᤂ§r → §fᤀ§r
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.sp:
Can only be used while §fᤀ§r.
Teleports you to the point you are looking at within %2$s blocks. Grants 2 scint charges.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds. §fᤀ§r → §fᤂ§r
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.da:
Can only be used while §fᤀ§r.
Turns the player into a dark meteor that flies forward for a %3$s seconds with a readily rising speed. When colliding with a block or an enemy, the meteor explodes, dealing damage to all enemies in a %1$s block radius and giving them 1 antiscint charge. 
Cooldown: %2$s seconds. §fᤀ§r → §fᤁ§r.
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.sk:
Can only be used while §fᤁ§r or §fᤂ§r. §fᤁ§r §fᤂ§r → §fᤀ§r
Ascend into the air, summoning scint (§fᤁ§r) or antiscint (§fᤂ§r) crystals from beneath the earth for %2$s (+%5$s per scint charge) seconds. Crystals deal %1$s damage around the point of eruption, and when an enemy is by defeated this way, it either explodes and grants %3$s antiscint charge(s) to nearby creatures (§fᤂ§r) or heals you and grants you %3$s scint charge(s) (§fᤁ§r). This ability can be cancelled by pressing Shift. Cooldown: %4$s seconds.
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.re:
In a large area, swaps scint charges on the caster with antiscint charges on enemies. Can be used while §fᤁ§r or §fᤂ§r.
§fᤁ§r: Deals damage based on received scint charges
§fᤂ§r: Freezes enemies for 2 seconds per antiscint charge received.
Cooldown: %2$s seconds. Passively increases your max scint charges and enemies’ antiscint charges by %1$s.
Upon activation, doubles the gained Skint charges for the next 20 seconds.
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.da: "Dark Star" can now home in on a creature you select as a target. In this case, it can maintain its state for a significantly longer duration.
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.sp: If the target is a creature, it receives two Antiskint charges.
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.pl: After using the ability, the blind, mighty Wardens lose all interest in movement and noise, and burrow back underground.
With a %3$s% chance, nearby creatures attacking the player will start attacking each other.
relics.description.knef_bow.ability.shot: +1 experience point for each «Moonlight Arrows» hit.
relics.description.knef_bow.ability.stor: +1 experience point for each point of HP healed by «Heaven's Wrath».
relics.description.ronas_sword.ability.s: +1-3 experience points for each «Rhonas' Venom» stack on a slain enemy.
relics.description.ronas_sword.ability.f: 25% chance to get +1 experience point for each new «Rhonas' Venom» stack on a target.
+1 experience point for every 25 blocks mined with the Hammer.
+1 experience point for each block of ore extracted with «Montu's Strike».
relics.description.seliaset_horn.ability: +6 experience point for each enemy stunned by «Nature's Rhythm»
relics.description.knef_rose.ability.und: +1 experience point for each bone consumed by «Ghostflame Protection».
relics.description.knef_rose.ability.liv: +1 experience point for each time a «Living Flesh» attacks its target.
relics.description.knef_rose.ability.rot: +1 experience point for each split by «Unholy Rebirth»
+1 experience point for each crop grown by «Bountiful Light»
+1 experience for each heated block or item by "Unbearable Heat"
+1 experience point for each point of damage blocked.
+1 experience point for each enemy knocked away with either «Lion's Rebuke»
+1 experience point for each enemy knocked away with either «Furious Charge»
relics.description.scroll_of_truth.abili: +1 experience point for each 5 points of vanilla EXP acquired.
+1 experience point for each EXP level spent on enchanting.
+1 experience point whenever it saves an item's durability.
Earns relic XP equal to the XP levels you saved after using the forge.
+4 experience points when using a Pocket Smithing Table or Pocket Anvil
+1 experience point for each healed HP.
+10 experience points when creating a mob's book.
relics.description.jodah_staff.ability.r: +1 experience point per vanilla experience point lost hitting with Jodah staff.
relics.description.jodah_staff.ability.h: +2 experience point for each health drain.
relics.description.jodah_staff.ability.o: +3 experience point for every teleport with "A thousand eyes" ability.
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.pl: +3 experience points for every HP healed with "Planeshift".
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.sp: +3 experience points for each activation of "Sparkslip" ability.
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.sk: +1 experience point for each kill with "Skint Genesis".
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.re: +1 experience point when mob with Antiscint charge is damaged by any way, +1 for every 3 charges.
relics.description.jodah_mask.ability.da: Gains as much experience points on "Dark Star" explosion as big this explosion is.
relics.description.traveller_sword.abili: +1 experience points every 2 seconds at maximum speed.
+2 experience points whenever you cut through enemies at maximum speed.
+8 experience points for each activation of ability.
+3 experience points when you slash through a mob while dashing forward.
thirteen_flames.relics.call.keybind.desc: Hold %1$s to open active abilities menu.
